title: CPF Module Schema: Mongo vCore Cluster
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-mongocluster'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

admin_login.description: (Optional) The administrator's login for the mongo cluster.

admin_password.description: (Optional) The password of the administrator login.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

cluster_name.description: (Required) The cluster name of the mongo database.

content_type.description: (Optional) Specifies the content type of the Key Vault Secret.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

create_mode.description: (Required) The mode to create a mongo cluster. The acccepted values are Default, PointInTimeRestore, Restore.

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

high_availability.description: (Optional) Whether high availability is enabled on the node group.

high_availability_mode.description: The target high availability mode requested for the cluster.

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

key_vault_id.description: (Required) The ID of the Key Vault where the Secret should be created. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

key_vault_tags.description: (Optional) Key Vault related tags to be set on key vault child resources.

node_disk_size.description: (Required) The disk storage size for the node group in GB. Example values: 128, 256, 512, 1024.

node_sku.description: (Required) The resource sku for the node group. This defines the size of CPU and memory that is provisioned for each node. Example values: 'M30', 'M40'.

not_before_date.description: (Optional) Key not usable before the provided UTC datetime (Y-m-d'T'H:M:S'Z').

public_access.description: (Optional) Whether public access is enabled on the mongo cluster.

resource_group_id.description: The ID of the resource group where the Mongo cluster will be created.

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

shard_count.description: The number of shards for the MongoDB cluster

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

connection_string.description: The Connection String of the mongo vCore cluster.

id.description: The ID of the mongo vCore cluster.

keyvault_secret_name.description: The Name of the key vault secret.

keyvault_secret_resource.description: The Resource of the key vault secret.

name.description: The Name of the mongo vCore cluster.

resource.description: The Resource of the mongo vCore cluster.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Mongocluster' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
